body:
Well, I was able to make it work both on Cygwin/Fish and MSys2/Fish environments! 🎉

I hope the following will help you fix so that it could work out-of-the-box!

#### Pasting from my comment [here](https://github.com/starship/starship/issues/590#issuecomment-647795736)

> I know this is closed but for reference I wanted to leave a workaround that made me successfully have Starship working under Cygwin/Fish and MSys2/Fish.
> 
> Following [this comment](https://github.com/fish-shell/fish-shell/issues/5151#issuecomment-646764438) I was able to run `starship init fish --print-full-init` in the command-line and see that printed a path with "\\" instead of "/" so what I did was:
> 
> 1. get the full printed code (ran the command above inside my shell in MSys2):
> ```
> function fish_prompt
>     switch "$fish_key_bindings"
>         case fish_hybrid_key_bindings fish_vi_key_bindings
>             set keymap "$fish_bind_mode"
>         case '*'
>             set keymap insert
>     end
>     set -l exit_code $status
>     # Account for changes in variable name between v2.7 and v3.0
>     set -l starship_duration "$CMD_DURATION$cmd_duration"
>     "C:\msys64\usr\local\bin\starship.exe" prompt --status=$exit_code --keymap=$keymap --cmd-duration=$starship_duration --jobs=(count (jobs -p))
> end
> 
> # disable virtualenv prompt, it breaks starship
> set VIRTUAL_ENV_DISABLE_PROMPT 1
> 
> function fish_mode_prompt; end
> export STARSHIP_SHELL="fish"
> ```
> 
> 2. change the path to `C:/msys64/usr/local/bin/starship.exe`.
> 
> 3. Now instead of using `starship init fish | source` in my `config.fish`, what I did was just paste the entire (fixed) output there, so my `config.fish` ended up like:
> ```
> function fish_prompt
>     switch "$fish_key_bindings"
>         case fish_hybrid_key_bindings fish_vi_key_bindings
>             set keymap "$fish_bind_mode"
>         case '*'
>             set keymap insert
>     end
>     set -l exit_code $status
>     # Account for changes in variable name between v2.7 and v3.0
>     set -l starship_duration "$CMD_DURATION$cmd_duration"
>     "C:/msys64/usr/local/bin/starship.exe" prompt --status=$exit_code --keymap=$keymap --cmd-duration=$starship_duration --jobs=(count (jobs -p))
> end
> 
> # disable virtualenv prompt, it breaks starship
> set VIRTUAL_ENV_DISABLE_PROMPT 1
> 
> function fish_mode_prompt; end
> export STARSHIP_SHELL="fish"
> ```
> 
> And it works now. 🎉
> 
> ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1574224/85340272-2d97dd00-b4bc-11ea-9a2d-4dc5151f2b07.png)

PS: After I made it work, it was just a matter of changing "C:/msys64/..." <-> "C:/cygwin64/..." on the path depending on where I was configuring.
